title: NOAA ESI Outer Coast Washington/Oregon cetacean polygons
description: Static Ryu-hosted GeoJSON extracted from the NOAA 2014 Outer Coast Washington/Oregon ESI geodatabase. M_MAMMAL polygons are filtered through BIOFILE to whale, dolphin, and porpoise records.

caveats: ESI is an oil-spill planning and response dataset, not a real-time animal observation layer.
The GeoJSON is simplified for MVP browser rendering and filtered to cetacean BIOFILE records.
